answer: Escrowed sybil bounty turns fake clusters on themselves. Each identity stakes 60 credits; a summit panel verifies proofs, slashes the stake, pays the reporter 40 percent, burns the rest. The terrace ledger publishes stakes, proofs and payouts. Any insider can wander to the board and file one proof claiming the cluster bounty. Reporting k fakes pays 24k, so silencing k insiders costs 24k squared; the kth fake adds 48k. One thousand fakes stake 60,000 and face 24,000,000 in bribes. Rented silence fails, since each hire gains the same payoff. One honest agent stakes 60 once.
